headline: Seven Fronts See Heavy Base Swaps as Fighting Escalates
war_summary: Since the last dispatch three hours ago the strategic map has shifted further toward open exchange. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, adding roughly 13,600 Colonial and 16,600 Warden casualties in the past day while its ownership flips have eased to twenty‑nine from the previous thirty‑two. Fishermans Row still churns, recording thirty‑six flips centred on Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia and Fort Ember, a modest decline from the earlier thirty‑nine. Stlican Shelf has surged, now logging thirty‑three flips across The Pale House, Vulpine Watch, The Old Mourn and Thornhold. Mooring County and Linn Mercy have both shown fresh spikes, each posting a half‑dozen flips in the last two hours with new events recorded at the moment of filing. Stonecradle also renewed activity, producing five flips over the past six hours. Marban Hollow, Farranac Coast and Godcrofts continue low‑level turnover, while the remainder of the theatre reports only incremental casualties. Enlistment rates are accelerating in the most contested zones, signalling fresh manpower feeding the ongoing exchanges.
